title_sq: Duplex per shitje me pamje nga Liqeni i Thate!
description_sq:
Super duplex per shitje me pamje nga Liqeni i Thate.
Ne katin e pare te duplex eshte ambjenti i ndejtjes bashke me pjesen e gatimit dhe ngrenies, nje tualet, dhe shkallet te drejtojne per ne katin e dyte ku pozicionohet fjetja me dy dhoma gjumi ku dhoma matrimoniale eshte me garderobe, ne katin e dyte ndodhet gjithashtu nje tualet dhe aksesi ne veranden e apartamentit.
Apartamenti eshte i investuar dhe mobiluar me shije. Vetratat jane plastik me xhama triplex per me shume qetesi, eshte i shtruar me parket, sistem kondicionimi multisplit. Gjithashtu apartamentit i eshte bere sistem kapot per me shume izolim.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katet e fundit te nje objekti ndertuar rreth viteve 2013-2014.
title_en: Duplex for sale with a view of Lake Thate!
description_en: Super duplex for sale overlooking Lake Thate. On the first floor of the duplex is the living area together with the cooking and dining area, a toilet, and the stairs lead to the second floor where the two bedrooms are located, where the matrimonial room has a wardrobe, on the second floor there is also a toilet and access to the apartment's veranda. The apartment is invested and tastefully furnished. The windows are plastic with triplex glass for more peace, it is laid with parquet, multisplit air conditioning system. Also, the apartment has a hood system for more insulation. The apartment is located on the top floors of a building built around 2013-2014.
